title: Israeli Settlers Target Palestinian Olive Farmers During West Bank Harvest Season
detail: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian olive farmers in the West Bank during the annual olive harvest season, continuing a well-documented pattern of settler violence against agricultural workers. Olive harvesting, a key source of Palestinian rural income, is regularly disrupted by settler assaults and property destruction in the occupied West Bank.

title: Nine Palestinians Injured in West Bank Clash Between IDF Forces and Settlers
detail: Nine Palestinians were injured in a clash involving IDF forces and settlers in the West Bank, adding to a pattern of settler violence around the October 7 anniversary. The incident underscores heightened tensions in the region as the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack passed.

title: Israeli Strikes Kill Five in Gaza City, Medics Say
detail: Israeli strikes killed at least five Palestinians in two separate attacks in Gaza City on Saturday, October 10, 2026: one near Panda Mall killed four people and another in the Tuffah neighbourhood killed one. Gaza health officials say at least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli fire since the October 2025 truce.
